title: Palmarumycin P3 Reverses Mrr1-Mediated Azole Resistance by Blocking the Efflux Pump Mdr1.
authors: Song, Minghui; Zhang, Ming; Lu, Jinghui; Xie, Fei; Song, Jintong; Luan, Xiaoyi; Hou, Xuben; Lou, Hongxiang; Chang, Wenqiang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究化合物PP3通过阻断Mdr1外排泵逆转唑类耐药，分子对接仅涉及小分子-蛋白，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Palmarumycin P3 (PP3) reduces fluconazole-induced MDR1 transcription to reverse azole resistance in clinical Candida strains. Here, we demonstrated that PP3 restores the susceptibility to several antifungal drugs for Candida albicans strains with gain-of-function mutations in the transcription factor Mrr1. In addition, PP3 inhibits the efflux of Mdr1 substrates by C. albicans strains harboring hyperactive MRR1 alleles. Molecular docking revealed that PP3 is a potential Mdr1 blocker that binds to the substrate binding pocket of Mdr1.
abstract_zh: Palmarumycin P3（PP3）降低氟康唑诱导的MDR1转录，从而逆转临床念珠菌菌株的唑类耐药性。在此，我们证明PP3恢复了具有转录因子Mrr1功能获得性突变的白色念珠菌菌株对多种抗真菌药物的敏感性。此外，PP3抑制了携带高活性MRR1等位基因的白色念珠菌菌株对Mdr1底物的外排。分子对接揭示PP3是一种潜在的Mdr1阻断剂，结合于Mdr1的底物结合口袋。
